analysis.ci_pass_rate: 4/10 (best PSNR-mode CI on pair0: brightness_darken_shfit_HSV:2 + saturate_strengthen_YCrCb:2); signal-mode best 2/4 checks (pair0: noise:clean_residual + global:mean_shift); 0/4 support pairs reached MATCH/PARTIAL in verify_signals
analysis.mode: SIGNAL (dense-noise coupling + seed mismatch makes PSNR unusable for validation; PSNR only used to compare deterministic hypotheses)
analysis.rationale: Compression ruled out (block_boundary 1.0013-1.0022 on all pairs, unique_G 232~clean 234, dct_zero_ratio 0.239); blur ruled out (spectral_slope_ratio 0.927, FFT anisotropy 0, hf_lf_ratio within 11-28%). Global structure is content-dependent darkening consistent with gamma darkening (gamma_RGB sev3): pair0 mean_shift -34.1 vs target -34.7; pair1 -56.6 vs -53.1 (shadows crushed, 27% zero clipping, highlights preserved in degraded_1); pair3 (dark star-trail image) target var 0.36, clip 30%, mean -11.6 - all reproduced in direction by gamma. Chroma amplification (saturation_chroma_ratio 1.27-3.74, vivid neon colors in degraded_2, red-crushed statues in degraded_1) requires a chroma-space gain; 5/5 pairs show residual wavelet MAD sigma 0.74-1.24 while every simulated gaussian-YCrCb noise gives 9.9-15.6 and every impulse simulation produces 255-saturation values that the target does not have (pair0 target pct_255 ~0, 4.04% clipped values are all at 0) -> the chroma texture is amplified from the clean image's own chroma micro-texture by a deterministic saturate_strengthen, not added random noise. Saturation severity is the main open knob: YCrCb x3 measured chroma 1.58-1.90 (under target), unscaled noise is ruled out, hence primary uses YCrCb sev4 (x8, severity +/-1 uncertain), with the fully 5-pair-validated 3-step candidate kept as alternative #1. Local pattern: HSV S x64 (sev5) collapses the background to uniform saturated colour (PSNR 6.6) so HSV sev5 is excluded; YCrCb-space amplification is preferred because it preserves near-neutral pixels and the target keeps white pixels.
